review.summary: The implementation satisfies the requested PR generation, strict artifact reads, stable brief rendering, reviewer diff hoisting, template updates, and test coverage. One minor recovery-message edge case remains.

findings.title: Malformed external bundles receive impossible Git recovery advice
findings.detail: External bundles are explicitly supported and are not committed to Git, but factsHint always tells users with an unreadable finish/goals.json to “restore it from git.” The failure correctly blocks and names the file, but the recovery guidance is invalid when ws.Dir.InRepo is false. Use repository-aware guidance, such as restoring from Git only for in-repository bundles and repairing/restoring the named file otherwise.

internal.title: singleQuoted duplicates the existing shellQuote escaping algorithm
internal.detail: internal/cli/archive.go:353-355 already defines `shellQuote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", `'\''`) + "'" }` for exactly this POSIX single-quote close-escape-reopen technique, with a comment explaining the same rationale repeated almost verbatim in the new singleQuoted's doc comment (internal/brief/brief.go:265-274). The new PRTitleQuoted (internal/brief/brief.go:275-281) reimplements the same one-line escaping rule in a different package instead of sharing it, so a future fix or hardening of the shell-escaping rule (e.g. for control characters) has two independent copies to update.

internal.title: Body path interpolated unquoted in the same shell command whose title is carefully quoted
internal.detail: `gh pr create --base {{.Base}} --title '{{.PRTitleQuoted}}' --body-file {{.PRBodyPath}}` quotes the title (via singleQuoted/PRTitleQuoted, added specifically because a shell would otherwise split the command on spaces) but leaves `--body-file {{.PRBodyPath}}` bare. PRBodyPath is finish.PRPath(bdir), an absolute path under the workspace/repo root, which can contain spaces just as much as any other filesystem path — the exact risk internal/cli/archive.go's shellQuote (used for discardSweep's `git clean -fd -- '<rel>'`) exists to guard against ('a worktree path is whatever the user's filesystem says — a space in it would otherwise split the command into arguments'). brief.go:279-280 asserts PRBodyPath is safe to interpolate bare 'since it is takt's own <bundle>/finish/pr.md', but that reasoning is exactly what shellQuote's own doc comment rejects for repo/bundle-relative paths. The same command should quote both arguments.
